summary: A sharply marginated round right lower lateral pleural-based opacity on prior has resolved on current, while new bilateral hazy interstitial opacification has appeared.

findings.rationale: Prior shows a well-defined, dome-shaped, sharply marginated round density at the right lower lateral chest wall/costophrenic region consistent with a loculated pleural collection; the matched location on current (same rib level and lateral chest wall) shows normal lung markings without that density.

Current shows new diffuse bilateral hazy, indistinct interstitial-appearing opacification in the mid and lower lung zones that was not present on prior, corresponding to an interval clinical change (new endotracheal tube and additional lines suggest acute decompensation). Caveat: overlapping tubes/leads and different exposure make part of the difference uncertain.
